text.p: Chartwell Leisure Inc said on Thursday that it has terminated its proposed underwritten offering of 4.5 million shares, and instead will raise $51.5 million through a rights offering and private stock placement.
Chartwell will offer existing shareholders up to 2.145 million common shares at $14 in the rights offering, from which it expects to raise about $30 million.

The company also has reached an agreement in principle to sell 1 million shares at $14 to funds managed by Brahman Management LLC, which is affiliated with George Soros. This would boost the Brahman-Soros group's stake in Chartwell to about 10 percent.
Chartwell also said it had agreed to sell 535,000 shares to Baron Funds at $14, for a $7.5 million investment.
The funds raised will be used to build new hotels under Chartwell's recent alliance with Hilton Hotels Corp, among other purposes.
